holidays.name: Answer the Telephone Like Buddy the Elf Day
holidays.description: Pick up every call today with Buddy's cheerful greeting from the movie Elf: "Buddy the Elf, what's your favorite color?" Spreading holiday cheer through a phone line is the goal.
holidays.origin: It's a pop culture observance inspired by the 2003 Christmas comedy Elf, starring Will Ferrell. It appears on holiday calendars on December 18 and has no official sponsor that I could verify.
holidays.funFact: In the film, Buddy answers the phone in the Gimbels toy department with this greeting. It's one of the movie's most quoted moments.

holidays.name: Bake Cookies Day
holidays.description: A day for preheating the oven and making cookies, ideally enough to share with neighbors, coworkers and anyone who walks past the kitchen. Any recipe counts.
holidays.origin: It's a food observance listed on December 18 in holiday calendars, timed for the holiday baking season. I couldn't verify who created it.
holidays.funFact: The word "cookie" comes from the Dutch word koekje, meaning "little cake."

holidays.name: National Ham Salad Day
holidays.description: A salute to the humble spread of ground ham, mayo and pickle relish. It's a good way to use up holiday ham leftovers on sandwiches and crackers.
holidays.origin: It's a food observance listed on December 18 by holiday calendars. It lands during ham-heavy holiday season, though I couldn't verify who started it.
holidays.funFact: Ham salad is a classic way to stretch leftover holiday ham into several more meals.

holidays.name: National Wear a Plunger on Your Head Day
holidays.description: Exactly what it sounds like: stick a (preferably clean) plunger on your head and embrace the silliness. Photos are encouraged.
holidays.origin: It's a goofy observance listed on December 18 by holidays-and-observances.com. I couldn't verify who started it.
holidays.funFact: A plunger works by suction, which is why it sticks to a smooth, flat surface like a forehead.

holidays.name: National Roast Suckling Pig Day
holidays.description: A day for celebrating the festive centerpiece of many holiday feasts, a whole roasted young pig with crackling skin.
holidays.origin: It's a food observance listed on December 18 in holiday calendars. Roast suckling pig is a long-standing holiday and celebration dish in many cuisines. I couldn't verify who founded the day.
holidays.funFact: A suckling pig is a piglet that is still nursing, usually just a few weeks old.
